polygonHelp: Use a freeform outline for an irregular area.
rectangleHelp: Draw on the map, or add this object in an available space.
generateHelp: Seats are numbered automatically within the section.
rowHelp: Drag between the two endpoints of row {{name}}.
selectHelp: Select an item to rename, move or duplicate it.
emptyHelp: Add a stage, standing zone or seated section to begin.
svgSourceHelp: Use an SVG with defined sections and seats to bring them in as editable objects.
backgroundHelp: Use a PNG or JPEG as a guide to draw on top of it.
csvSourceHelp: Add existing seat positions. Section codes include {{codes}}.
objectRemoved: Removed. Use Undo to restore it.
invalidOutline: Draw a closed outline without crossing its edges.
overlap: This section overlaps another. Draw it in an empty part of the map.
tooManyObjects: This map has reached its limit of 500 objects of this type.
noSpace: There is no space for an object of this size. Resize it or make room on the map.
invalidGrid: Check the row and seat counts and the starting seat number.
rowOutside: Draw the entire row inside the selected section.
seatLimit: This map can contain up to 100,000 seats.
duplicateSeatLabel: This row already has a seat with that number.
moveBlocked: Keep objects inside the map and sections clear of each other.
